text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Fan Fest is a celebration held for Umamusume fans.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And T.M. Opera O has prepared something special just for it…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Musical theater, naturally! An operetta, in case you were still in the dark!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: I have assembled an all-star cast from my generation to announce our presence to the world!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: The star playing the role of King is no other than… me, of course!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: And the king's right-hand servant, Knight A, shall be played by… Meisho Doto!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I-I'll… uh… try really hard!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Um… I'm happy to play the role of your friend… but…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: What I really wanted to do was… Aaah—

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: And my next subordinate in the role of Knight B is…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Admire Vega, aka Ayabe! Last time we saw each other was during the Classics, no?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I… took time off because I had no choice. I still haven't recovered…

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I wonder if this is okay—acting in a play when I can't race.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Your character, Ayabe, is a knight who turns on me and beats me to a pulp.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Well then… count me in.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, the curtain rises on the trio's opera!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Indeed! So long as I am here with you two by my side, the future of this kingdom remains bright!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: We will sweep away the older generation's umbral shadow that hangs over the lands!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: We will sweep it away…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: The older generation's shadow… But that means Grass Wonder and them…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I-I don't know about this… I… Ohhhh…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Now, Ayabe, this is the scene where you commit your betrayal.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Declare your conviction on high and become my enemy.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Okay, here I go…

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Hehe, how naive, Opera O—not to notice the snake in your own court…

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Your true foe isn't the previous generation. Your true foe is…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: MEEEEE!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Huh? Doto?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Hm? That was not in the script. Has Doto turned this into… opera improv?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The unexpected twist stuns even Opera O.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: For… for a long time now, I've wanted… to face off against you!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I couldn't accept your offer at first… So the role I wanted was passed to Ayabe.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: It tore me up inside… Even if for just a moment, I wanted you… to see me!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I've trained a lot. I've been in lots of races. Now… I'm so close to G1!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I might not make it to the spring Tenno Sho, but…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I can definitely make it to the Takarazuka Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I want to run with you, Opera O! But this time, as your opponent!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: So… race me! PRETTY PLEASE!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Doto, I never…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Doto is really showing her heart, unspoken feelings now bursting free.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Oooh, tell me it isn't true! Doto, whom I'd believed to be my friend, is a conniving traitor!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: What has become of our ironclad kinship?! Doomed. Our generation is utterly doomed.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Before our battle against the older generation could commence, our consortium has degraded into chaos and disarray!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Hyeeeee! Opera O, I'm sorry! I… I just…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Woe is me… Wait, could it be?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Hehehe… Destiny has shown its cards. This is the curse of the royal blood that runs through my veins!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Do your worst, Doto! I, T.M. Opera O, shall neither flee nor hide!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Haaah ha ha! Go forth and spark the civil war that will rend our nation in two!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huuuh?! Are you happy or angry? I can't tell!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I wouldn't worry too much. This one lives for drama.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Doto… I'm rooting for you.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Thanks, Ayabe…

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Your effort… isn't in vain.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I mean… you just got me out of this. Heh, I pass the baton to you.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: O-okay…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Now that you have made your declaration, there is no turning back. You have become my enemy!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: A rift runs through this generation of ours… And it grows larger by the minute.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: You must face me now, before the showdown against our predecessors can take place!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: O-okay! Let's do this, Opera Ooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The new turn of events greatly increases the excitement in the audience.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Before Opera O can challenge the generation before her, she must settle the disarray now plaguing her own.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Murmur, murmur…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Some discourse has begun brewing in the stands, though.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Hey, I don't think they're acting. Like, that was a real fight, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: No way! Who'd pick a fight with Ope when she's so popular? Won't all her fans be ticked off?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huh… S-so many people are looking at me… But why? Urghh…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fans start glaring down at Meisho Doto once they realize she wasn't acting.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The number of die-hard T.M. Opera O fans has grown a lot recently. And now they've found a target.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Aaagh… I'm sorry… R-really…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: If I was too out of line, then we can… go back to the way it was.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Do not stand down, Doto!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: O-Opera O?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: You took the stage of your own volition, so you mustn't!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: You must not retreat! Maintain your courage! Step onto the stage in this momentous occasion as the knight you are!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: And a message to my fans—how pathetic!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A fiery Opera O tears into the audience.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: An enemy she may be, but she deserves your love. If you were my fans, then you would open your hearts to be as unprejudiced as mine.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Besides! A work of theater without twists and surprises is the very definition of boring!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Yes, Meisho Doto is both my friend and my foe…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: As with the older racers who stand in my way, I wish for you to accept her as a part of this tale!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Hear me well! Send your best wishes to the full cast of this wonderful age!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooooo!

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text: That was awesome, Opera O!

text_block_list.name: Fan D
text_block_list.text: Spoken like a true star!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Opera O…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Doto, there is no taking back the words you gallantly declared.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: You must face me now, before the showdown against our predecessors can take place!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: O-okay! Let's do this, Opera Ooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With the air of a true king, T.M. Opera O brings the play to a close.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She has also gained a new and important mission with today's surprise—to settle competition among her own generation before taking on the old.
